text:
Predicates:
MemberOfPappys(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
StarredIn(x, y) ::: x starred in y.
Series(y) ::: y is a series.
PilotedIn(y, z) ::: y was piloted in z.
Network(y, z) ::: y aired on network z.
WorkingTitle(y, t) ::: y had working title t.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
Premises:
Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's. ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three. ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults. ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults. ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (MemberOfPappys(x) ∧ StarredIn(x, badults) ∧ (Network(badults, bbcTwo) ∨ Network(badults, bbcThree))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
